notes: The music video stays on the song that is playing: a change has to hold for two ticks before another film is loaded, so it no longer takes turns between three songs.
Leaving a music video pauses the music on the second the picture stopped, instead of starting the song again by itself.
The equalizer, the volume boost, the anti-muffler and the duck reach the music video sound too, because its audio is read and played through the same chain as every song.
